contracts.purpose: Represents a normal scalar-track container for ordered curve bindings.

field_semantics.kind: The semantic kind of the track container.
field_semantics.title: The requested human-readable title of this track.
field_semantics.bindings: Ordered curve bindings; repeated channel references remain distinct bindings.

distinctions: A normal track is not a source candidate and does not select a filesystem path.
A track title is not a curve scale.
examples: A normal track titled Calibration can contain a curve binding for CALX.

contracts.purpose: Represents an array-track container with an explicit horizontal numeric domain.

field_semantics.x_scale: The horizontal numeric domain of the array track.
field_semantics.bindings: Ordered raster bindings whose sample semantics remain on each binding.

distinctions: track.x_scale is not automatically binding.sample_axis.minimum or binding.sample_axis.maximum.
An array track does not authorize channels outside the resolved source context.
examples: An array track titled Array View can use ARRAY_Q with x scale 10 to 90.

contracts.purpose: Represents one scalar source channel drawn as a curve.

language_patterns: <channel> with a linear scale from A to B
<channel> with a log scale from A to B
<channel> with a logarithmic scale from A to B
<channel> with a tangential scale from A to B

field_semantics.channel: The exact mnemonic of the selected scalar source channel.
field_semantics.scale: The numeric display scale of this individual curve.

distinctions: A curve-specific numeric range maps to binding.scale, not track.x_scale.
Do not infer reverse=true when reversal is not requested.
Repeated channel references in separate requested views remain separate bindings.
examples: CALX with a linear scale from -25 to 75 maps its range to binding.scale.
A requested reversed curve preserves reverse=true in binding.scale.

contracts.purpose: Represents array samples from one selected source channel.

field_semantics.profile: The semantic interpretation family of the raster samples.
field_semantics.sample_axis: Explicit semantics for the raster sample dimension.

distinctions: sample_axis describes the raster sample dimension, not the array track horizontal x_scale.
sample_axis.minimum and sample_axis.maximum require explicit sample-axis semantics.
Profile names describe semantic raster interpretation and are not source filenames.
examples: A synthetic raster named ARRAY_W can use profile waveform.
A sample unit ms, source origin 12, source step 2, and 5 ticks map to sample_axis fields.
